purpose: separate dataset effect from training-recipe effect: CC152K parent trained with the R30 v1.1 H recipe (vs R37C on the R31-H parent)

data.observed_pairs: real observed CC152K pairs, no injected noise (noise_ratio 0, noise_file none)
data.splits: train + dev only (node-local staged copies); TEST never staged, never read

parent.boundary: R30 boundary: after warmup epoch 5 of both peers + full-DEV validation (parent_state.pt, PARENT.json)

recipe.hyper: r25_run defaults (batch 128, lr 5e-4, lr_update 15, margin 0.2, grad_clip 2, queue 65536, p_threshold 0.5, workers 0, fp32 no AMP)

checkpoint_rule: model_best.pth.tar = co-train epoch (0..39) with the strictly highest peer-averaged full-DEV rSum (first maximum on ties; best_rsum starts at 0 at the boundary, warmup epochs never eligible) -- the native r25_co_train rule used by R30 H0

hardware.block: GPU_BLOCK.json = GPU type of the first attempt; parent warmup, continuation and every resume attempt on that type

resume: self-resubmission on timeout (same partition/time/nice), at most 4 attempts in total; continuation resumes its own state_last.pt; a warmup interrupted before the boundary save restarts the warmup from the seed (deterministic init)
test: no TEST evaluation registered or run by this line (main session decides with the user)
_publication_note: Public excerpt: identity/hash/receipt/host fields and per-problem rows omitted, sample names pseudonymized, numbers unchanged.
